03 / PLATFORMER

Platformer

Jump, grab, reach the flag.

CRYSTALS0
BEST0
Reach the flag. Grab crystals on the way!

How to play

Make your way to the flag and scoop up crystals along the way.

  • ← → or A / D to move
  • Space or ↑ to jump

Keep moving

Land on each platform, then jump for the next ledge.

Fall off? You pop right back at the start. Your crystals stay with you.

ARROWS OR A / D TO MOVE · SPACE OR ↑ TO JUMP · TOUCH BUTTONS ON MOBILE
